The '''Mavva system''' was located in the [[Aparo sector/Legends|Aparo sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[Mavvan Conflict]],<ref name="CSWE Gaff">{{CSWECite|I|307|Gaff}}</ref> which was fought at some point between [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]].<ref name="Dates">{{DroidsCite|The Frozen Citadel}} establishes that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was involved in the [[Mavvan Conflict]], and ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] of the Empire to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. In addition, {{PolyhedronCite|170|Star Wars Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO}} dates the events of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO]]'', which includes the episode "[[The Frozen Citadel]]," to fifteen [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before those of {{Film|IV}}, which corresponds to [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]] per ''The New Essential Chronology''. Therefore, the Mavvan Conflict must have occurred at some point between those two dates.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Mavva [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square R-3.<ref name="TEA" />
